proposals.explanation: Adds an auth-policy factory selecting BearerTokenAuthenticationPolicy for a token credential, otherwise HmacAuthenticationPolicy for a key, and throws when neither is available. Replaces NotificationMessagesClientBuilder.createHttpPipeline to install that policy after retry and date policies while assembling logging, user-agent, request-ID, context-header and per-call/per-retry policy stages.
proposals.handwrittenRationale: The script explicitly adds the factory and replaces the pipeline method body for the named builder; the resulting auth-selection implementation is supplied without a Generated annotation.

proposals.explanation: Selects bearer-token auth with DEFAULT_SCOPES when tokenCredential is present, otherwise HMAC auth from the key, rejecting missing credentials. Replaces MessageTemplateClientBuilder.createHttpPipeline to include that factory after retry/date policies and to assemble the surrounding header, telemetry, extension-policy and logging stages.
proposals.handwrittenRationale: The script explicitly changes both method bodies for this builder, and the unannotated policy-factory source confirms the credential-selection behavior.
